items.title: Beyond the Infinite Two Minutes
items.reason: A cafe owner discovers that two screens are linked across a two-minute interval, and the group spends nearly the entire compact runtime testing, extending and exploiting the temporal phenomenon. The mystery is less about uncovering its ultimate cause than learning its operating rules: the initial future/past link expands into a recursive Droste setup that reveals progressively farther-ahead events, forces characters to confront apparent predestination and paradox, and makes earlier props and actions matter later. Whole-film reviews support strong mystery density, unknown-rule exploration and revelation cadence, while also noting repetition, a light comic mode and that the film deliberately does not explain much about the phenomenon's origin. Cause uncertainty and central mystery are therefore kept moderate rather than inflated; the strong time anomaly, unknown rules, weirdness, containment and steady rule discoveries still clear the live baseline threshold.
